steps.title: Jun Ito: repair appointment checklist · part 1
steps.detail: Jun Ito asks for a repair appointment checklist. Their evidence contains an unresolved question. What should the first draft do?

choices.label: Document the question and ask for evidence

steps.title: Jun Ito: repair appointment checklist · part 2
steps.detail: The repair appointment checklist now has conflicting notes. Jun Ito wants a version that other people can check. How do you resolve the conflict?

choices.label: Compare sources and record what remains uncertain

steps.title: Jun Ito: repair appointment checklist · part 3
steps.detail: Jun Ito is ready to introduce a paying client for the repair appointment checklist. The client asks for a promise you cannot verify. What do you put in the handover?

choices.label: State the agreed scope, limits and evidence

referral.detail: A referred client commissions a documented repair appointment checklist. Complete the agreed work; no revenue is earned merely for knowing Jun Ito.
